entries.headline: Built Soccerdle footballer-guessing prototype
entries.summary: Authored a Wordle-style footballer guessing game with a Python ETL pipeline, PostgreSQL data model, plain Node server, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. The prototype compares guesses across nationality, position, leagues, clubs, and birth year.

entries.headline: Expanded J-Mail with AI triage and inbox RAG chat
entries.summary: Merged a unified Gmail inbox foundation plus AI-assisted triage and an Ask panel. The work adds message categorization and flags, local embeddings, hybrid vector/full-text retrieval, reranking, Claude-powered tool use, and citations back to email records.

entries.headline: Implemented session-only thought development for Margin
entries.summary: Merged a local writing-coach prototype feature for temporary thought-development sessions, including session notes, contextual entry, temporary article shapes, copy/discard flows, structured response validation, and related tests.
